title: Synthesis and characterization of a solvatochromic urea-schiff base derivative: Investigating optical properties, hydrogen bonding effect, copper ion sensing, computational analysis, DNA and beta-cyclodextrin interactions.
authors: Alhagri, Ibrahim A; Al-Hazmy, Sadeq M; Alammari, Sarah S; Alminderej, Fahd M; Messaoudi, Sabri; Aroua, Lotfi M
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究一种尿素-席夫碱衍生物的溶剂变色、铜离子传感及与DNA和环糊精的结合，包含DFT计算和DNA对接，但核心是化学传感而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: This study investigates the fluorescence behavior of the synthesized compound (E)-1-(4-chloro-2-(((2-hydroxynaphthalen-1-yl) methylene) amino) phenyl)-3-(naphthalen-1-yl) urea (3DB) in various solvents. A significant increase in fluorescence intensity was observed when transitioning from ethanol to less polar solvents like CH(2)Cl(2), CHCl(3), and CCl(4), indicating enhanced fluorescence due to reduced non-radiative processes. Emission wavelengths remained stable with minor shifts (5-6 nm), while significant blue shifts in absorption occurred in water due to strong hydrogen bonding. Fluorescence spectra showed red shifts (519 nm in water, 508 nm in glycerol, and 486 nm in ethylene glycol), highlighting the impact of hydrogen bonding on electronic transitions. Emission intensity in water was six times higher than in ethylene glycol, suggesting that strong hydrogen bonds stabilize the excited state. The study also revealed that 3DB exhibits a large Stokes shift, avoiding reabsorption of emitted light (inner filter effect). Fluorescence was completely quenched by low concentrations of copper ions, demonstrating 3DB's potential as a copper sensor. Density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) calculations indicated that luminescence quenching in the Cu(II) complex is due to intramolecular charge transfer (ICT). Additionally, 3DB formed stable complexes with DNA and beta-cyclodextrin (beta-CD), with binding constants (K(b)) of 1.30 x 103 M(-1) and 1.89 x 103 M(-1), respectively, and negative Gibbs free energy values, indicating spontaneous interactions. Fluorescence spectroscopy confirmed DNA binding, showing a 49.62 % increase in intensity and a 4 nm blue shift, consistent with groove-binding. Docking studies further supported favorable interactions with DNA. These results underscore 3DB's potential in sensing, imaging, environmental monitoring, and biological applications.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了合成化合物(E)-1-(4-氯-2-(((2-羟基萘-1-基)亚甲基)氨基)苯基)-3-(萘-1-基)脲（3DB）在不同溶剂中的荧光行为。从乙醇过渡到极性较低的溶剂如CH(2)Cl(2)、CHCl(3)和CCl(4)时，观察到荧光强度显著增加，表明非辐射过程减少导致荧光增强。发射波长保持稳定，仅有微小偏移（5-6 nm），而在水中由于强氢键作用，吸收光谱出现显著蓝移。荧光光谱显示红移（水中519 nm，甘油中508 nm，乙二醇中486 nm），突显了氢键对电子跃迁的影响。水中的发射强度比乙二醇中高六倍，表明强氢键稳定了激发态。研究还揭示3DB具有大斯托克斯位移，避免了发射光的重吸收（内滤效应）。低浓度铜离子完全猝灭荧光，展示了3DB作为铜传感器的潜力。密度泛函理论（DFT）和时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT）计算表明，Cu(II)配合物中的发光猝灭归因于分子内电荷转移（ICT）。此外，3DB与DNA和β-环糊精（beta-CD）形成稳定复合物，结合常数（K(b)）分别为1.30 x 103 M(-1)和1.89 x 103 M(-1)，吉布斯自由能值为负，表明相互作用是自发的。荧光光谱确认了DNA结合，显示强度增加49.62 %和4 nm蓝移，与沟槽结合一致。对接研究进一步支持了与DNA的有利相互作用。这些结果强调了3DB在传感、成像、环境监测和生物应用中的潜力。
